canonical_project: FutureData Park first Global Telecommunications data centre
owner: FutureData Sdn Bhd consortium (TSG Group and Cyclect) / Global Telecommunications Group
notes: FutureData's Sarawak park was announced as a renewable-energy data centre park in Kota Samarahan/Kuching. Data Center Dynamics reports the first Global Telecommunications facility will have 17 MW IT capacity, cost about US$130 million, start construction in Q2 2025 and target operation in 2026; public sources do not yet confirm completion.
